note: Reviewer names omitted. Order is the Play page default, not by date. Not a complete set. In this sample 266 of 540 reviews are 1 or 2 stars (49%); the shown order is the page's default, so these counts are not the app's overall rating.

reviews.text: Was working great until the last week. Every morning it keeps saying a person on my life360 has left and returned home when they haven't left at all. Also shows a map as if some of us are moving around on our properties all night and it is saying we are driving way faster than we are. This is going to get kids in trouble when they are actually not speeding. My app is completely updated. I've already uninstalled and reinstalled but it didn't help. How do I fix this?

So untrustworthy and inaccurate. The location can be "accurate" within a distance of about half a mile. Not helpful in many situations. That's if the app updates a person's location at all. Often, it shows my husband or one of my kids still at our home or at a place they were much earlier in the day and it stays stuck at that location for many hours. We always check for updates when it starts acting up and there aren't any. We've had to log out and back in or even uninstall the app and reinstall

Used to be a good app. Lately, the app loses connection with locations. The screen comes up blank. I can not see the location of anyone in my circle. I have to force the app to stop and then go back into the app. It will work a few times, then stop again. Very annoying. So I was asked to contact support, I did. Their solution was basically to log out and log back in. I have to do this several times a week. What a pain. Well, now the app crashes every time it comes up. No longer works on android.

For the most part, I love the app as it gives me peace of mind in knowing where my family is, especially when they are traveling. However, it's not always accurate. My family member can be in one place (verified) but the app will show otherwise (and no their phones were not left behind). There are delays (lagging) in the app, as well. I have the Gold membership, because of the added benefits due to the amount of traveling my family does. Really wish this app would improve its accuracy.

Overall, I love Life360. It works amazing to track the phones of friends and family along with fun emojis, accurate location, as well as battery updates. I just bought my first Tiles, and after finding them for a much better deal on Amazon, I went to cancel my order through the Life360 App. Unfortunately, they didn't let me cancel it. I got to the customer support chat maybe within 10 minutes of placing my order and they said they couldn't cancel it; be careful ordering through them.

We've used and loved this app for 10 years. But over the last year it has changed so much that we are switching to something else. This one is no longer reliably accurate. You now have to have every single permission in your phone on at all times, which drains the battery, or you dont get even basic location info. The UI is also annoying. If you try to scroll the list of users, it selects the single user you touch first. You have to retry several times to get the list to scroll.

not showing speed when one of us is out driving been a few days like this please fix it's just being very glitchy. It's like they're hopping instead of driving, and we paid for the gold, so please fix it. I don't know if anybody's ever told you all. But when somebody crashes, it doesn't always alert, even with that turned on for alerts an update popped up, I did it, and it's still just as bad

This app used to be great. lately, everything is a mess. I've tried to get help from customer service with no response. The names of locations are completely wrong. My family can be in the exact location, and it will have us each at a different address but in the small location. Also, the time we are home or anywhere is chopped up. Instead of saying we were home 12 hours, it updates it every few hours, causing the time a the location to be chopped up. And the new physical activity is crazy.

Don't subscribe. I got charged twice for my membership in 1 month after having it for over 2 years. Customer service did not care, refused to acknowledge it was 2 charges and tried telling me it was 1 charge despite me having 2 identical $26.49 transactions 1 second apart for my 1 membership, which they saw on their end, and did nothing about it. The app also will get slow and glitch. It crashes and is down a lot more often than expected, multiple times per month.

For how expensive this is per month, it shouldn't be sending me "deals" for tile tracking when I don't want even more subscriptions. This app also will not shut up about battery saver notifications. literally every 5 minutes it will pop back up and there no way in app to turn this off. I KNOW ITS OFF. I HAVE IT OFF FOR A REASON. STOP TELLING ME. Theres also no dark mode and often times the actual notifications are delayed, if they send at all, and its starting to get more buggy.

It helps a ton especially in the morning when the kids haven't left for school on time. What a really great app this is! I didn't want to get any app for tracking in the beginning, I was talked into it, I'm happy I added it now because it turned out to be so useful. The kids can see where everyone is and it's easy to get a ride from someone that's close by. Or noticing if someone is at a fast food place and you want some food too! 😆

I can't stand when apps appear to give you options but are designed to not operate unless you choose the option they want. On one screen it allowed me to choose"only when using the app" but on the next screen, it would not continue unless I selected "allow all the time" which I was reluctant to choose. Because the app shares information from my Google account with third parties. Therefore, it refused to allow me to finish setting up unless I went back in and changed that option.

It rarely works now. I'm paying a monthly subscription for something that's useless. Since that Sept. 7th update, I can't even use it. The screen stays blank for 5 to 15 minutes when opening the app. All the satellite maps are so blurry you can't so things on the map. It doesn't update locations for hours sometimes. We have great wifi and great signals. The only thing that changed is this app.

really useful app but the near constant "Updating location.." and "checking for activity" notifications are so annoying. And I can't turn just these ones off. It's either all of them or none of them. and the useless notifications are on every 10min it's so annoying and distracting. I start to ignore actual relevant notifications because I just assume it is that one. Can someone fix that?

The app is too inflexible with its permission requests. The requests are more like demands. If the app is missing a single permission, it claims it can't function properly and repeatedly sends pop ups to you AND your family members telling them to reach out to you and grant the permissions. It's also a huge drain on the battery with no battery performance options available.

The app does what it says and the interface is intelligently organized. Go with the free version unless you need to keep track of a lot of specific places, have a need to track their branded RFID tags, or do not already have roadside service. One noteworthy negative has to be navigating among the four subscription tiers. Upgrading is quite easy and can be done within the app itself. Downgrading, however, involves a multi-step process outside the app they probably hope customers forget.

The app is pretty good most of the time but sometimes is very inaccurate. It says I am leaving work when I am really at home and it says my family member is in a SW address when the person is in the NW. Also sometimes it doesn't refresh. It's a little slow and glitchy. I have to sign out and sign in again so it can update and work fine. Please work a little on more accuracy, Life 360.

It's great because it's free and capable in Android or iPhone, but a huge drawback is that it usually doesn't track in real time, so whatever you're tracking could already be somewhere else. The average is probably 30-60 minutes behind, and the further from other phones the subject is, the longer it could be.

Lately this appa is recording all wrong. It keeps telling me I am using my phone while my phone was in the backpack in the trunk. I am not even letting connect hands free. Also says I am speeding or hard breaking while it was supposed to consider speeding, only speeds above 80 mph, and I use cruise control to keep my car at 78 mph. Also, no hard breaking at all. It does not matter how carefully I drive, my stats come all screwed up. Fix that! 09/16/26 update: 2 risky events that did not happen!

Glitchy garage app. The location is often incorrect and doesn't update. Yes, I have good reception. It should also work with battery saver in use. I get constant notifications telling me to turn off the Android battery saver feature. Skip this piece of junk and just share your location in Goggle Maps. It always works. I was considering the paid version of Life360 but not until it's fixed.

2024 ..I upgraded to get the full usage of the app and it's never been worse. If it's not glitching it's not showing the right locations. If it's not showing me the wrong thing in the notifications telling me someone arrived but they just left it's so wrong. They have reached out and their solution every time is to delete the app and then reload the app. update 2026 still doesn't work correctly but I keep it for family that have iPhones and it works for them. still barely works for me.

update... I used to love Life360. your WHOLE point is to give and show location. you can't even pinpoint that on top of us sending out false location notifications. I really don't know what I'm paying for. maybe the tile? being able to get unlimited notifications when they arrive? IDK.. but now you have the nerve to raise your price AGAIN $2 more dollars. What a joke.

I'm extremely disappointed in how many features that used to be a part of the free version now have to be paid for... and no, I'm not just a cheapskate. I have willingly paid for the premium subscription when I've had the need. Now that my kids are older, needs have changed. Stating that free gives 2 days location access is incorrect. It is more like 24 hours. For a Life360 early adopter.. the monetization of every little thing is just a bummer. 😢

ok so i use the free version and love it! it is super accurate on location and actually sends notifications when one off us get to a place that is set to notify. the only reason I did not give life360 five stars is because it limits how many places I can get notified when they arrive at the set location and honestly I can not afford right now to buy the subscription to unlock more. just wish it had an option to at least give 4 or 5 more locations. still my go to app for family tracking app ❤️

I just got the app to use tiles, I don't want to connect to any other people ever. So I blocked most of the location access and background battery usage. I get constant notifications about needing to "fix" permissions, which thankfully I can block at the phone level. But every single time I open the app I get a giant popup saying "Location sharing doesn't work unless you fix your permissions!" There is a toggle in the fing app to disable location sharing, but I still get the popup!!!

The pop up nags about permissions are annoying. They pop up every time the app is opened. It sends spam notifications so I don't want to allow them. But the app doesn't like that and constantly tells me to enable them. The app itself works very well. It's nice that they made it free to use. The location is fairly accurate. The only problem I have is battery usage. Some days it uses 10-15% of my battery. Other days it's only 3-4%. Not sure why it varies so much.

it's a great app but it's a little busy on the interface of each family member I am tracking. also the app does not distinguish correctly between bicycle and bus. when my 13 year old is taking the bus it shows a bicycle 95% of the time and a car 5%. she should not be on either. the first rating thing is on the regular free app it limits the notification to only one. it used to be more. please add at least one or two more free notifications of arrival.

Worked good for months but since I got a new phone my location lags and doesn't update for 5 minutes to an hour most times, is missing drives or has inaccurate drive information, doesn't give timely notifications, and has other incorrect or missing data. Real time location for the people in my circle is the only reason I have this app so hope they fix it soon or we'll need to find another option.

the app used to be great to use now it lags all the time. half the time I've restarted my phone just to see if that would help and it doesn't. went into the so-called " chat " but that's not working either. can't update location names, can't see current location, won't save anything I try to do. And there's no one to address this with, trash.

I have only used the free version but even after 2 years of not using it and changing phones (kept same number) I was surprised to get a notification early one morning that my sister (still had app) had been in a collision. I called her immediately to check and sure enough she was just in an accident involving a couple of 18 wheelers. I was notified before anyone had time to call 911 and this was all with the free version. Highly recommend and I will keep it installed now.

The app has great features but it keeps telling me to turn off power saving on my phone and those in my circle. There should be an option to "don't ahow this again". I need to have my power saving on to have my phone last through the day. if I turn it off my phone only last about half the time. I don't need exact up to the second location updates. An update every minute or two is fine. with power saving, it allows that. QUIT telling me to turn it off multiple times a day! I keep getting alerts

Great app! It is not spot on accurate common meaning. It does not track perfectly, i.e., lines take a shortcut from one distance to another, where the person you are tracking, you know, for a fact, did not drive. that part about it is why I gave it 4 stars. I just wish the lines were more accurate so you could follow the person properly.

Does its job. The crash alerts are fine, never had a use for them but it's nice having that sort of reassurance. My only complaint is I can't set myself as a passenger until well after the trip is over, & I tend to travel by train every so often, trains make pretty harsh stops that would be considered dangerous for cars & that reflects on the "drive report". I currently do not have a way to tell it "this is normal, it's a train". I don't know if they'll ever add it, but that's my two cents.

This app started out okay, but lately it's been incredibly slow to load and update locations during my husband's drive home from work. Half the time, I don't get notifications that he's left work until 15 minutes later, after I've already started to worry! (Just happened today, actually.) Also, I get super tired of the constant in-app marketing messages that don't go away until you've actually opened and read them. Lots of features locked behind a pay wall, too. Not super impressed.

The battery optimization notification is incredibly annoying. Every single time I tap on one of my kids in the app, the same "Optimize Battery" warning pops up. Yes, I know battery optimization is enabled, and no, I don't want to disable it. There should be a way to dismiss this message permanently. It's an unnecessary interruption that makes using the app frustrating.

I wish they would get rid of the stupid quick notes. I'm a truck driver and my kids like to look at life360 to see where I am but they like to hit the quick note buttons. While I'm driving and listening to podcasts, it's so frustrating when I get notification every few seconds. The only solution is to disable all notifications but I still need important notifications.

the last month this app has been extremely unreliable. not all locations are picked up. there is a major lag of anywhere from 5 minutes to an hour on departure and arrivals. some locations and event aren't even recorded, even if they are at that location for hours, no record of it. also the battery detection of other members is inaccurate now by 30 minutes, to hours. in app messages and emojis are often not being received. 360 needs a major update. the tile commands continue to reset to default.

My old two star review for not being available on tablets or the web didn't make much impact. now it's a one-star review because the app is being gamified. An unremovable 'RED CARD' button recently appeared on the map screen. Tech support tells me it's for the world cup, and will disappear when the games are over. That's fine, but give me the option to make it disappear TODAY. I don't want to play games in 360. And what will the next game be with a big button on the screen?

It is not completely accurate, but it does show the location your at within a two block radius. Sometimes it might even be half a block away. Don't count on it for accuracy. It has some issues to work out. It shows a new members phone is off when it is in fact on. I tried to connect with support, but it even that is useless. So frustrating. The app needs work. 8-12-26 app is glitching again.

All of sudden - with no changes from any of my family's settings - this app has stopped showing me past routes. it now only shows how long someone has been at a location, though it's usually off. the live tracking still seems to work, but I really need those routes saved again. that was its big draw, and if it can't do that anymore, then I might as well look for something that doesn't drain our batteries so bad. I've cleared data, cleared caches, uninstalled & reinstalled but nothing changes

typo or coding error- when I try to scroll through the history, it says "your plan includes just 2 days of location history" but it only shows 2 hours, which is really frustrating. Also, I get that they want you to buy the premium version, but I feel like it asks you so frequently that the app is becoming more and more useless. seriously? 2 hours of history?

This app works as it should. You're able to keeptrack of friends and family, crash reports, and severe weather. for that I love it. I don't like them selling my information, making my insurance rates go up because im a passenger and the app can't tell. I don't want to keepgetti g notifications every 20 min to optimize my battery and let them track my physical activity. If I don't want to track those I shouldn't be harassed.

Not at all what I thought. I thought this was a great way to keep up with important items, but it's all about building community, surveillance, grading your driving, it's not that accurate and it's obnoxious with it's "reminders" to give it more permissions. I don't recommend if you just want something to keep up with items and an app that doesn't send a request for permission every 2 hours.

used to be great, now it isn't worth it. you can't see how far away anyone is (distance or time) which is the primary feature i used it for. i recently switched to samsung from iphone and quickly learned the app practically harasses you about trying to save your battery life. the notifications are literally neverending. the location itself is rarely accurate, lags, and moves around constantly even when the person isn't going anywhere. it's just really difficult to use

Great until last update. Horrible new interface for Android. With the new interface you no longer can tell how far away someone is from you. If I want to get an idea when someone in my group is going to arrive I no longer can see just by tapping on their name. My wife's iPhone shows it just like my used to. If it ain't broke, don't break it. I used that feature more than almost any other.

Lately the tracking hasn't been as reliable. I don't receive notifications, like my partner reaching or leaving work. I open the app, and see they made it there, or left, but even then I may, or may not, receive the updates until some minutes later. I'm paying good money on this app, and feel like I at least deserve the notifications.

Used to be a nice clean simple reliable app. Have been using it for 5 years. Helped a lot when my kids were younger making sure they were getting places safe. But the past year the app has gone way downhill. The location is no longer accurate, when I or my wife leave home every morning it does not update location until we are at work, and will just show a straight line instead of the route traveled. The live location map is now jammed with stupid widgets, blocking the map they get hit, sucks.

The tracking in this app gets worse and worse with each given update. The app is also intentionally leaning to pushing more promotional content everyday. I've gotten an ad when opening the app trying to check on family. and not only did the ad make the app lag super bad, the ad was also super hard to click out of *like normally* and as soon as you click off the add another tiny sponsor pops up! Also started pushing something called "Nift gifts"*just Google it* all of it is just a money grab now

Update: So not only does it not work consistently, my son was in a bad accident and the crash detection didn't work at all! Despite being turned on and paying for the upgraded membership. Not sure what I'm paying for at this point. Thank god he was alert enough to call for help! Original review: Works occasionally but not consistently. App says it can't locate my son because he's in battery saver mode but I'm looking at his phone and he's not. So it's unreliable.

So disappointing. I paid for the premium version, yet the tracking is incredibly glitchy and delayed. Someone will literally be standing in front of me for 10 minutes before I even get the "arrived" notification. They relentlessly harass you with pop-ups to upgrade, only to deliver awful service once you actually pay. Waste of money. I down graded this week and I still had a week left and got bombarded with pop ups lett me know I only had X days left. this app is terrible. 👎🏻 Do better!

most things are pretty decent but the five pop ups every single time i open the ad is insane. if i put that i dont want it tracking my heartbeat and stuff then it needs to just accept that not shove a pop up in my face every time the app opens. ofc this goes for the other pop ups too. its very distopian that it demands to know my steps and stuff. it just makes the app feel like another cheap ad game. i do consider those pop ups ads.

not necessarily all the apps fault, it could be GPS inaccuracy or possibly cell service. But, it shows the person that I use the app with constantly coming and going. even at night while the app seems to have enough sense to show them as sleeping and immobile. It isn't a huge issue as it correctly shows where they are. But the constant alerts "x left home" "x arrived home" lead to me ignoring the alerts. The app doesn't seem to use a lot of battery on my phone, but it does on my Other's phone.

Good technology but extremely annoying app. Continually asks to turn on features, notifications, alerts, wants you to "Go to set up" and add people, places, etc, and won't take "No" for an answer. Wants to know everything about your life and family and pets and won't quit bugging you. Will never take no for an answer. When you try to back out of one of their forced set up screens, the app just to minimizes. Yeah, the app is like a fly at a picnic that just keeps landing on your food.

It's a good app to keep track of your kids. The only thing I don't like is, every time I open it, I am asked to turn on notifications and then it asks to allow access to my device's physical activity. I don't want either of those things, but it asks every time I open the app. These are minor things, but annoying. I don't want to have to close a couple pop-up screens before finding out where my kid is.

This app used to be phenomenal, but with the recent updates, it has steadily declined. I have a mixture of android and iPhone users in my circle. Since the last update, all of the iPhone users are displaying the message "Physical activity permissions off," but clearly shows that they're ON in the settings menu. Very frustrating!

Highly inaccurate when checking in locations and the time spent there. Also, the driving reports are awfully incorrect. Thought this app would help my family know I'm safe while I'm at school but I'm constantly having to reassure them I'm at the correct location and how long I was there almost every day. It also concerns me when I'm wanting to make sure individual family members are safe too.

I like the app but it drains my battery if I don't use battery saver. Then it prompts me every time I open it which is really annoying. you'd think after a hundred "no's" it could take a hint. It srill drains my battery with saver turned on. Developers refuse to make it more efficient or allow you to turn off the prompt.

Overall the app is good. Just some minor things that are concerning. 1. The app shows that I have arrived at home about 1/2 mile before I actually get there and that I leave my house after about a mile. 2. It does not always show the previous activities that have been completed throughout the day. My kids can spend an entire day out driving around town and it will not show the locations they have been to. I understand not all apps are perfect but this was not an issue I faced several months ago.
1 person found this review helpful

Many issues: 1. It uses too much of a person's battery. 2. It's never accurate in real-time, always 30 minutes to an hour behind. 3. You can't keep the battery optimizer on without constant notifications to turn it off, but if I do, my battery will only last 3 hours due to the app using so much. 4. You can't hide the constant notification about the battery optimizer. It's annoying as hell to constantly get notifications, and then you try to hide it, but it refuses to let you!

Okay I'm giving this a 3 star review because it's really reliable sometimes and other times it's not. Idk if my phone is outdated so much that this app isn't working, but it has caused alot of problems for me and my partner. It gives him notifications that I left my house in the middle of the night to go to some random person's house while I'm asleep in my bed. He hasn't had any problems with this app so far with anybody else. Idk what's wrong with this app, but I hope it gets fixed soon.

Great app all around. Only thing I'd change is when you add a new member to your circle to be able choose whether or not to get notifications for that person or not right away instead of just getting them and needing to go change them afterwards. I hate hearing my phone go off any time someone moves, so I (like most ppl) choose who in my circle to get certain notifications for n who I don't get any from. It'd be faster n much easier to choose to get notification for them as soon as they're added

All too often when I need to find someone it gives me the location they were at an hour before... I have lost count of the number of times everyone in our group has been forced to restart their devices. The app keeps trying to upsell premium features, but the base one doesn't work much of the time. How could I justify paying for extra when I can't rely on the base service to work. Maybe in a major metropolitan area this is not normal, but Southern Minnesota doesn't work very good.

Life360 gives me peace of mind as a parent. I love being able to see where my family is, especially my teenage son, and the driving features are a huge plus. The only reason I'm giving 4 instead of 5 stars is because the arrival and departure notifications can be delayed. Sometimes I don't get the alert until several minutes after he's already arrived. If those notifications were more consistent and immediate, this app would easily be 5 stars.

Love the app. However, over the passed week or so it stopped notifying me when someone arrives or departs a location. Also it has stopped showing the person moving on the map. It stays in one place while they are driving and then skips ahead and stops again. We've tried emptying the cache etc but nothing helps. Would love a fix for this.

My biggest complaint is that suddenly I am no longer getting the notifications when people arrive/depart. All my settings are on to get the notifications but they just stopped 3 days ago. I pay for the subscription but no longer get notifications. This app is great though overall when notifications work, it does have a slight lag but that's manageable.

an ok app, but the CONSTANT nagging about membership is annoying. JUST STOP. I'm a grown person, if I want to become a paid member, I can figure that out on my own. The constant "pop-ups" just get in the way of the app actually working. If anyone reading this agrees, give them a 1 star rating until they get the hint.

I can't even get back into the app. I try to log in with Google but it puts me back to the either number or email sign in option. Number doesn't work because it put it in and it gets rid of it from the box. email doesn't work either as the code never sends no matter how many times I resend it. Only given about 3 tries in total, otherwise it says 'Something went wrong. Try again'. App is buggy, so don't recommend it at all for user ability.

I've had Life360 for many years. I'm giving it three stars now because for the longest time it was working well but more recently for the past several months the app has been having issues we're not all family members are popping up and sometimes you have to force close out of everything to get it to work properly. When it does work how it's supposed to, the app is amazing.

Update: this app is even buggier and freezes even more than it did a few months ago. Just keeps getting worse. Used to be great, now basically useless. It won't refresh when you manually try and several people just become offline no matter how many times they set their settings to allow in the background. It doesn't update locations live anymore and tracks members speed incorrectly, showing multiple 195+ mph drives which is impossible.

Been using this app for years. Since end of July wont update. Cant see history for half the day, map is white and slow to load right away. Hitting refresh works only part of the time. So place alerts are just not happening or happens hours later. Talked to support and reinstalled app after clearing data and all cache. All permissions are accurate but it still wont work. Would like to keep using app since I pay for it, but disappointed in this bug.

I have had this App for over 10 Years and it worked great until you changed the design recently. It sucks..It drives me crazy everytime I tap on a Member and all the Members are running around the map. If it is not broke, don't fix the damn thing. Stop trying to get fancy. We just want to track individual Members without pictures of all of our Members in a bubble dancing around the page. I did not signup to be in a bubble. The original format worked great. I would give this App a big fat 0.

This app is such an annoyance. There is no reason why an app that works just fine (as in terrible) with my battery saver on should be bombarding me to turn it off. And please, please remove the limit of seeing risky events next to loved ones' locations. For them, it seems like money has become a lot more important to them than actual safety to loved ones. If I wasn't forced to keep this app, this would be deleted immediately.

The BIG Thing is it says: Your speed is four or so over the speed you are going. This app doesn't keep up with where people are and most of the time it says you are walking while you are driving and sometimes riding a bike instead of driving. If you all can fix it then I would give it a better .⭐⭐⭐ The time is off on this app as well.! 2nd glitch it doesn't separate your trips. It also doesn't seem to pick up the correct lane you are driving in!🙎

Update: They app still sucks. It fails to update frequently, I have to manually request a refresh in order to see updated locations. Members will move from home to work, but life360 doesn't show a drive. Used to be great, now the app doesn't work as intended. 5 days of all my circles showing all parties with paused locations but none of us have or locations paused. App is falsely saying drive completed but showing no drive when you open the app. Not worth the subscription anymore.

randomly out of the blue this app has stopped working entirely. I have done everything in my power to get this app to stop logging me out every time I click out of the app, I cannot get notifications to work at all (like arrival notifications when my wife gets home or leaves) it just gives me a sorry excuse of "Check connection and try again" then immediately forces me to log out. this app worked for years, but this entire year of 2026 it has not worked once. Better off NOT getting this JUNK!

Both of us enjoy being able to keep track where the other one is. But the driving report is a joke. I've been unable to drive due to surgery and yet according to the app, I'm driving on half the trips we make together. Plus since the phone usage portion is totally wrong and I'm assuming the hard braking and fast take off info is basically wrong as well.
1 person found this review helpful

I appreciate the ability to keep up with my loved ones when they are on the road. Unfortunately, you need data to use this outside of a wifi area, so I occasionally loose my elderly father's location. The other issue I have is sometimes the location is off slightly and addresses are easily confused. Otherwise it's great.
